func literal(value any) expression { return func(scope, string) (any, error) { return value, nil } }

func readValue(item bool, path []string) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		value := context.input
		if item {
			if !context.bound {
				return missing, nil
			}
			value = context.item
		}
		for _, key := range path {
			if isMissing(value) {
				return missing, nil
			}
			object, ok := value.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				return nil, refusal(at, "object_value", "member access encountered a nonobject")
			}
			value, ok = object[key]
			if !ok {
				value = missing
			}
		}
		return value, nil
	}
}

func fieldValue(object expression, name string) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		value, err := object(context, at+"/object")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if isMissing(value) {
			return missing, nil
		}
		fields, ok := value.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			return nil, refusal(at, "object_value", "member access encountered a nonobject")
		}
		value, ok = fields[name]
		if !ok {
			return missing, nil
		}
		return value, nil
	}
}

func recordValue(fields []member) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		result := make(map[string]any, len(fields))
		for _, field := range fields {
			value, err := field.value(context, pointer(at+"/fields", field.name))
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if !isMissing(value) {
				result[field.name] = value
			}
		}
		return result, nil
	}
}

func listValue(items []expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		result := make([]any, 0, len(items))
		for index, item := range items {
			value, err := present(item, context, fmt.Sprintf("%s/items/%d", at, index))
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			result = append(result, value)
		}
		return result, nil
	}
}

func fallbackValue(value, fallback expression, onNull bool) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		result, err := value(context, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if isMissing(result) || (onNull && result == nil) {
			return fallback(context, at+"/fallback")
		}
		return result, nil
	}
}

func chooseValue(test condition, yes, no expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		result, err := test(context, at+"/condition")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if result {
			return yes(context, at+"/then_value")
		}
		return no(context, at+"/else_value")
	}
}
